none: PAS CAM-19BCAD: Roman coin : Nummus of the House of Constantine - [GLORIA EXERCITVS].
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy nummus of the House of Constantine, AD 307-361 (Reece period 17). Reverse legend reads [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. Reverse shows two soldiers, one standard. Mint is uncertain, AD 335-341. Obverse legend is illegible. Obverse shows an unclear, and obscured by concretion product, probably draped and cuirassed, bust right. Die axis is 6 o'clock. Weight is 1.42g, diameter is 15.3mm, thickness…
